integrity: The reference literature is credited for generation theory and maximal-subalgebra obstructions; complete bibliographic priority is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless quivers with radical-square-zero quotient; all q and positive tuple lengths. No assertion for self-loops, higher radical layers, or non-unital generation. Enumerations corroborate but do not prove the general theorem.
title: Exact generating-tuple law for radical-square-zero quiver algebras
